title: The Chemist Who Sold Nirma From His Bicycle on the Way to Work
conflicts: Launch price Rs 3/kg (Business Standard, Nirma site) against Rs 3.50 (Indian Express, Indian Television); 'about Rs 3' used. Comparison: cheapest brand or Surf at Rs 13 (Nirma site, Indian Express, Indian Television) against 'one-third the price of the cheapest popular detergent' (Business Standard 2010); both attributed. Daughter Nirupama (Business Standard, Indian Television) against Nirmala (Indian Express); Nirupama used. 60% share by 1988 is only ever 'reported', so it is attributed that way. Start-up capital (Rs 700 or a Rs 15,000 loan) and the year he quit his job appear only on weak sites, so both are left out.
notes: No first-person interview with Patel exists in the sources found, so the story gives no thoughts or founder quotations; it rests on Business Standard (2010, 2014, 2016), the Indian Express, Indian Television and Nirma's own site. Stance 'affirms'.
